Resources and references

A source trail for every study, plus a route into typography, archives, and practical tools.

How this guide is put together

The 20 Design Lab Workshop directions are the starting set. Twelve additional studies cover other historical and digital approaches. Short overviews, practical exercises, and SVG specimens are original work for this guide.

StyleShift provides introductory movement context. Web Design Museum provides historical website records. Typography Learning connects the vocabulary to practice. These labels include movements, eras, techniques, and moods; they are not equivalent categories.

The desktop navigation is an original CSS interpretation of Apple’s 2001 website: silver tabs, fine stripes, inset edges, and blue selected controls. No Apple logo or original navigation artwork is copied.

Original study illustrations are labeled separately from externally hosted historical screenshots. Archive images remain the work of their respective creators. A source link is not a reuse license. Remote archive images may be unavailable; the archive-record link remains usable.
